description.zh: 外呼组编号；说明：以外呼组编号为筛选条件查询
description.en: The agent group ID used to filter the query results.

description.zh: 外呼组名称；说明：以外呼组名称为筛选条件查询
description.en: The agent group name used to filter the query results.

description.zh: 需要取出的数据条数；说明：大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: `1` to `1000`. Default value: `10`.

description.zh: 从第几条开始取；说明：大于等于0，默认0
description.en: The index of the first entry to return. The value must be greater than or equal to `0`. The default value is `0`.
